verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents that apps can delete messages, attachments, and notes, and can choose whether a sent message is saved in Sent Items. That gives basic, item-level deletion control. Nothing in the pack covers retention policies, automatic expiry, account-level data deletion, or how long Microsoft keeps data, so the retention half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, automatic deletion or expiry schedules, account or tenant-wide data purge controls, provider-side retention guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
